title: Otori Emu — I'm The Meow-Meow Monster!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tapey-tapey-tape-tape, tapey-tape♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, our posters for volunteering to pull weeds are all up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I hope lots and lots of people decide to sign up... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The girls outside the classroom are looking at our poster! Does that mean they're interested? If so...)

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line:
Hi there!
Do you happen to be interested in volunteering...?
A few days later
Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
You could only get one person to sign up?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes...
So, combined with the people you got to sign up, that makes three in total...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: To be fair, you just put up that poster the day before yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And feeling bad about ourselves won't solve anything, so why don't we keep trying to come up with new ideas?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
Let's see... Then, what if we...?
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Asahina and I brainstormed a lot together, but we couldn't come up with any ideas that felt just right...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Honami helped make our poster really amazing by drawing all those great pictures for us, so anyone who spots it should be able to see how fun it's gonna be...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What if they aren't...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What if they can't see how making everything nice and squeaky-clean by pulling out all the weeds would be fun and make them feel really happy...?)

rows.Speaker: Hinata's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Sis?!
Come on in!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Sorry, I know it's late.
I just got back from that trip and brought back some souvenirs for you. Here you go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! It's one of those regionally-themed taiyaki keychains! I really love these☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks, Sis!
Hehe. I wonder what color the paste inside it is♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, what's that on your desk? A poster for something...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right...!
I'm doing some volunteer work as a class rep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm in the middle of trying to recruit more people to come pull weeds with me...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: And you're running into some trouble?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-H-H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was written all over your face.
You seemed a little down.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Also, pulling weeds is usually very hard work. People must be thinking that having to do it in the heat would be incredibly exhausting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I knew it...!
Another class rep in the year above me said the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, how have you been trying to recruit people?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I've been putting up posters like this one... And talking to anyone who seems interested!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whenever someone stops in front of one of our posters, I fly over towards them and tell them about how fun it's gonna be☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I see. You're trying to invite individual people who spot your posters...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: This is just my humble opinion, but I feel that it'd be better to try reaching out to a large group of them all at once.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All at once?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes. For example, you could ask the teachers to see if they'll let you make an announcement in the morning or before school gets out.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I know it's easier to get your message across to someone when you talk to them one-on-one, but it's also very time-consuming, no?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Speaking to multiple people all at once should save you quite a lot of time. Plus, any who decide to sign up may try to convince their friends to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I never would've thought of that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Which means I've still got a lot to learn...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: There are many ways to go about an issue like this. And what I just said isn't necessarily the only solution.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: However, it's good that you're able to come up with so many ideas on your own. I'm sure you'll learn to see things from different angles as you keep gaining more and more experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay! I promise to keep trying...!
Thanks for the advice, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Do your best, class rep! I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna get lots and lots of people to volunteer to pull weeds with us!
